unitJackal.name: Jackal
unitJackal.longDescription: A quick wheeled scout with a light gun, suited to probing terrain and chasing exposed targets.

unitLynx.name: Lynx
unitLynx.longDescription: A tracked opening skirmisher that delivers accurate burst fire while holding ground better than light rovers.

unitDaddy.name: Harvestman
unitDaddy.longDescription: A walking support platform combining a compact beam with a small powered shield for nearby assaults.

unitBadger.name: Badger
unitBadger.longDescription: A durable advanced tank that launches slow guided rockets against important ground and air targets.

unitMongoose.name: Mongoose
unitMongoose.longDescription: A mobile advanced mortar platform that attacks clustered enemies from beyond ordinary direct-fire range.

unitTick.name: Tick
unitTick.longDescription: A queen-spawned crawler that uses a compact beam to harass targets while remaining expendable.

unitHuman.name: Macaque
unitHuman.longDescription: A nimble bipedal combatant with a light gun, useful for early bot pressure and screening.

unitRex.name: Tyrannosaurus
unitRex.longDescription: A dinosaur titan carrying beams, gatlings, and rocket batteries for overwhelming late-game assaults.

unitMammoth.name: Mammoth
unitMammoth.longDescription: A massive tracked tank whose heavy cannon trades speed and flexibility for decisive direct damage.

unitFormik.name: Antlion
unitFormik.longDescription: A multi-legged artillery unit that keeps up rapid mortar pressure from behind the front line.

unitWidow.name: Black Widow
unitWidow.longDescription: A towering crawler protected by a full shield and armed with multiple beam emitters.

unitHippo.name: Hippo
unitHippo.longDescription: An amphibious tracked assault unit whose gatling weapon stays useful across shorelines and shallow water.

unitSeaTurtle.name: Sea Turtle
unitSeaTurtle.longDescription: A surface-capable naval skirmisher with burst fire and a chassis built to cross shorelines.

unitOrca.name: Orca
unitOrca.longDescription: A submerged attack craft that uses torpedoes to hunt ships, submarines, and other underwater targets.

unitTarantula.name: Tarantula
unitTarantula.longDescription: A fast advanced crawler with a compact beam, suited to flanking and pursuing vulnerable targets.

unitLoris.name: Loris
unitLoris.longDescription: A tracked reflector platform that aims powered mirror armor back toward weapons targeting its host.

unitBee.name: Bee
unitBee.longDescription: A queen-spawned drone that contributes a compact beam while swarming around larger airborne hosts.

unitDragonfly.name: Dragonfly
unitDragonfly.longDescription: A hovering attack craft combining drop mortars and a light gun for flexible close support.

unitConstructionDrone.name: Construction Drone
unitConstructionDrone.longDescription: An airborne builder that starts aircraft and universal fabricators while assisting any active construction site.

unitEagle.name: Eagle
unitEagle.longDescription: A fast fixed-wing fighter that uses guided missiles to intercept airborne threats.

unitDuck.name: Duck
unitDuck.longDescription: A beam fighter that transitions continuously between air and water without changing its physical simulation.

unitAlbatros.name: Albatross
unitAlbatros.longDescription: A heavy fixed-wing siege craft whose paired cannons deliver long-range fire from a broad airframe.

unitQueenBee.name: Queen Bee
unitQueenBee.longDescription: An airborne capstone that combines long and short beams with production of expendable Bee drones.

unitQueenTick.name: Queen Tick
unitQueenTick.longDescription: A crawling capstone that combines long and short beams with production of expendable Tick crawlers.

unitTransport.name: Pelican
unitTransport.longDescription: A tractor-beam aircraft that carries one visible friendly or enemy unit without disabling its weapons.

unitCommander.name: Silverback
unitCommander.longDescription: The starting commander combines construction authority, heavy beam fire, and a manually aimed disruptor.

unitConstructionSubmarine.name: Construction Submarine
unitConstructionSubmarine.longDescription: An underwater builder that starts naval and universal fabricators while assisting any active construction site.

unitHedgehog.name: Hedgehog
unitHedgehog.longDescription: A tracked rocket platform whose unguided shot flies straight, rewarding deliberate positioning and leading.

unitRadarScout.name: Kestrel
unitRadarScout.longDescription: An unarmed airborne scout that extends allied radar coverage far beyond ordinary visual range.

unitConstructionBot.name: Construction Bot
unitConstructionBot.longDescription: A bipedal builder that starts bot and universal fabricators while assisting any active construction site.

unitConstructionRover.name: Construction Rover
unitConstructionRover.longDescription: A wheeled builder that starts vehicle and universal fabricators while assisting any active construction site.

unitStealthScout.name: Cuttlefish
unitStealthScout.longDescription: A fragile cloaked naval scout whose radar stealth lets it approach contact networks without announcing itself.

unitDetector.name: Owl
unitDetector.longDescription: A mobile airborne detector with modest sight that reveals cloaked enemies without providing radar coverage.

unitRadarJammer.name: Manta Ray
unitRadarJammer.longDescription: A naval jammer with a weak light gun that suppresses enemy radar contacts around its position.

unitMissileRover.name: Swift
unitMissileRover.longDescription: A fast rover with guided missiles restricted to airborne targets, providing mobile anti-air cover.

unitClusterArtillery.name: Bombardier Beetle
unitClusterArtillery.longDescription: An advanced artillery vehicle whose heavy mortar splits into medium shells over clustered targets.

unitWaterStrider.name: Water Strider
unitWaterStrider.longDescription: A crawler that fights and holds position on both land and water with burst-fire armament.

unitPatrolCorvette.name: Barracuda
unitPatrolCorvette.longDescription: A water-only surface combatant combining an above-water gun with sonar for underwater contact support.

unitPetrel.name: Petrel
unitPetrel.longDescription: A cross-domain aircraft that launches torpedoes into the water while relying on allied sonar contacts.
